ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Name one consumer of the plants in this food web.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. At the lower left there is a plant node labeled “Plants,” and the diagram also has animal nodes such as “Ants,” “Tadpoles,” and “Ducks.” It can be seen that there are arrows starting from the “Plants” node, one of which points to the ant labeled “Ants.” Reasoning: Arrows in a food web indicate that energy or food goes from the source being eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, the arrow from “Plants” to “Ants” shows that ants eat plants and are a consumer of plants.
